The Miami City Brand

Every great city carries a name you can wear on your chest.

New York has I ♥ NY. Los Angeles roars it in Dodger blue. Chicago wears the Bulls. Paris says je t'aime.

Miami has the sunsets, the rhythm, the ocean, the skyline. And now, a name of its own.
